planner_plan.global_summary: A cinematic tour of Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris, showcasing its Gothic architecture through varied perspectives and seasons. The video moves from exterior shots of the grand facade, intricate stonework, and gargoyles to interior views of the soaring nave, stained-glass windows, and reverent atmosphere. It transitions between ground-level walks, interior explorations, and high vantage points on the cathedral's roof, offering panoramic views of Paris. The journey captures the cathedral in different lighting conditions—overcast skies, golden hour, and snowy winter days—emphasizing its monumental presence and serene beauty.
